description: This file defines a PHP class `perf_db2` that is part of a performance monitoring library for DB2 databases. It contains SQL queries and methods for analyzing database performance metrics, explaining SQL statements, and retrieving table information. The class extends `adodb_perf` and includes configuration settings, creation of log tables, and utility functions for performance analysis.

classes.name: perf_db2
classes.description: A class for performance monitoring and tuning of DB2 databases, providing SQL-based metrics retrieval, query explanation, and table information.

methods.name: perf_db2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a database connection.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan explanation for a given SQL query, optionally partial, by interacting with DB2 explain tables.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves and displays information about database tables in the current schema.
